writing:wr:31.hint: ある事柄を特に疑問視せず当たり前だと考える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:31.answer: People often take it for granted that they can drink clean water.
writing:wr:31.fullSentence: People often take it for granted that they can drink clean water.
writing:wr:31.explanation: 当然のことと思うという意味。

writing:wr:32.hint: 他人をおもしろがってからかう、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:32.answer: The children made fun of his accent.
writing:wr:32.fullSentence: The children made fun of his accent.

writing:wr:33.hint: 自分の考えていることを話し言葉にして表す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:33.answer: It is hard to express my feelings in words.
writing:wr:33.fullSentence: It is hard to express my feelings in words.
writing:wr:33.explanation: 言葉で表現するという意味。

writing:wr:34.hint: 文頭でBut, And, Soの代わりに用いる堅い接続語は何か。
writing:wr:34.answer: However, the plan was later cancelled due to bad weather.
writing:wr:34.fullSentence: However, the plan was later cancelled due to bad weather.
writing:wr:34.explanation: エッセイではBut等の代わりにHowever/Furthermore/Thereforeを使う。

writing:wr:35.hint: 時間を無駄に過ごさず、ある行為に使うという構文は何か。
writing:wr:35.answer: He spends a lot of time playing video games.
writing:wr:35.fullSentence: He spends a lot of time playing video games.
keyPhrases: spends a lot of time playing

writing:wr:36.hint: 一般的な事実や必要性を表す仮主語構文で、女性が一人で夜道を歩くのは危険だ、と述べる文はどう作るか。
writing:wr:36.answer: It is dangerous for women to walk alone at night.
writing:wr:36.fullSentence: It is dangerous for women to walk alone at night.
keyPhrases: it is dangerous for women to walk
writing:wr:36.explanation: It is 形容詞 for O to Vの構文。

writing:wr:37.hint: つい先頃ある行動を終えたばかりだと述べる時に使う時制の形は何か。
writing:wr:37.answer: I have recently finished reading that novel.
writing:wr:37.fullSentence: I have recently finished reading that novel.
writing:wr:37.explanation: 「最近」を表す副詞は現在完了と結びつきやすい。

writing:wr:38.hint: 一方が変化するにつれて他方も比例して変化する、という構文は何か。
writing:wr:38.answer: The older you become, the more difficult you find it to learn foreign languages.
writing:wr:38.fullSentence: The older you become, the more difficult you find it to learn foreign languages.
keyPhrases: the older you become, the more difficult
writing:wr:38.explanation: the 比較級, the 比較級の構文。

writing:wr:39.hint: 量がほとんどないことを否定的に述べる表現は何か。
writing:wr:39.answer: There is little hope of finding survivors.
writing:wr:39.fullSentence: There is little hope of finding survivors.
writing:wr:39.explanation: 否定的な「ほとんどない」を表すlittle。

writing:wr:40.hint: ある集団の中で1人もその行動をしない、という否定を表す構文は何か。
writing:wr:40.answer: No one in our class has ever been abroad.
writing:wr:40.fullSentence: No one in our class has ever been abroad.

writing:wr:41.hint: はっきりとした考えを持たずに何となく行動する、という様子を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:41.answer: He answered the question without any clear idea in mind.
writing:wr:41.fullSentence: He answered the question without any clear idea in mind.
keyPhrases: without any clear idea in mind
writing:wr:41.explanation: 何も考えずに、という意味の表現。

writing:wr:42.hint: ある行動を取ることが当然だ、もっともだ、という納得を表す構文は何か。
writing:wr:42.answer: You may well be surprised at the news.
writing:wr:42.fullSentence: You may well be surprised at the news.
writing:wr:42.explanation: ~するのももっともだ、という意味の構文。

writing:wr:43.hint: 長期間ある状態が続いていることを表す現在完了進行形の構文は何か。
writing:wr:43.answer: She has been waiting for the bus for over an hour.
writing:wr:43.fullSentence: She has been waiting for the bus for over an hour.
writing:wr:43.explanation: 継続を表す現在完了進行形。

writing:wr:44.hint: 何かに対して不満を感じてそれを口に出す、という構文は何か。
writing:wr:44.answer: Many residents complained that the noise was too loud.
writing:wr:44.fullSentence: Many residents complained that the noise was too loud.
writing:wr:44.explanation: 不満を言うという意味の構文。

writing:wr:45.hint: 他者に強制せず、そうする力を与える、という意味を持つ動詞構文は何か。
writing:wr:45.answer: This new device enables us to communicate more easily.
writing:wr:45.fullSentence: This new device enables us to communicate more easily.
writing:wr:45.explanation: ~を可能にするという意味の構文。

writing:wr:46.hint: 命令や依頼として必ず実行するように伝える構文は何か。
writing:wr:46.answer: Be sure to lock the door before you leave.
writing:wr:46.fullSentence: Be sure to lock the door before you leave.
writing:wr:46.explanation: 必ず~しなさい、という命令の構文。

writing:wr:47.hint: 規則や決まりによってそうすることになっている、という意味の構文は何か。
writing:wr:47.answer: Students are supposed to submit the report by Friday.
writing:wr:47.fullSentence: Students are supposed to submit the report by Friday.
writing:wr:47.explanation: ~することになっている、という規則を表す構文。

writing:wr:48.hint: 現在の事実に反して、もしそれがなければと仮定する構文は何か。
writing:wr:48.answer: If it were not for his help, I could not finish this work.
writing:wr:48.fullSentence: If it were not for his help, I could not finish this work.
keyPhrases: if it were not for his help
writing:wr:48.explanation: 現在の事実に反する仮定を表す構文。

writing:wr:49.hint: 現実とは異なる様子を、まるでそうであったかのように表す構文は何か。
writing:wr:49.answer: He talked as if he had seen the accident himself.
writing:wr:49.fullSentence: He talked as if he had seen the accident himself.
writing:wr:49.explanation: 過去の事実に反する様子を表す構文。

writing:wr:50.hint: 二つの物事を比べて、一方が他方ほどではないと述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:50.answer: It is not as difficult to learn Spanish as to learn Japanese.
writing:wr:50.fullSentence: It is not as difficult to learn Spanish as to learn Japanese.
keyPhrases: not as difficult to learn spanish as

writing:wr:51.hint: ある基準の何倍もの量であることを表す構文は何か。
writing:wr:51.answer: I have about five times as many books as my sister.
writing:wr:51.fullSentence: I have about five times as many books as my sister.
keyPhrases: five times as many books as

writing:wr:52.hint: メールを書き始める際に相手の近況を気遣う定型的な一文は何か。
writing:wr:52.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
writing:wr:52.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this email finds you well
writing:wr:52.explanation: メールの書き出しの定型句。

writing:wr:53.hint: 医師の診断結果を証明する文書を受け取ったことを伝える一文は何か。
writing:wr:53.answer: I have visited the doctor, who provided me with a medical certificate.
writing:wr:53.fullSentence: I have visited the doctor, who provided me with a medical certificate.
keyPhrases: provided me with a medical certificate
writing:wr:53.explanation: 診断書を提供してもらったという表現。

writing:wr:54.hint: 自分の成績が努力と能力を反映したものになることを望むという一文は何か。
writing:wr:54.answer: I am eager to demonstrate that my grade reflects my efforts and capabilities.
writing:wr:54.fullSentence: I am eager to demonstrate that my grade reflects my efforts and capabilities.
writing:wr:54.explanation: 熱望しているという意味の表現。

writing:wr:55.hint: 返信を楽しみに待っていることを伝えるメールの結びの一文は何か。
writing:wr:55.answer: I look forward to hearing from you.
writing:wr:55.fullSentence: I look forward to hearing from you.
keyPhrases: look forward to hearing from you
writing:wr:55.explanation: メールの結びの定型句。
